title: Requirement set (canonical document file)
description: One file per published requirement revision: data/requirement-sets/<slug>.json (slug convention: '<subject-slug>-<effective-year>'). Requirement sets are IMMUTABLE dated documents, not versioned entities: a revision is a NEW document whose 'supersedes' points at the previous one. 'subject' targets a merit badge today; ranks and awards reuse this schema unchanged. COPYRIGHT: requirement 'text' is Scouting America's. When verbatim text is present, set includes_official_text=true AND a 'text_rights' statement (enforced below) — the text is reproduced with attribution for non-commercial use and is NOT covered by this dataset's CC BY-NC-SA license. 'summary' (original paraphrase) is an optional supplement. See NOTICE.md.

subject.description: The badge/rank/award these requirements belong to, e.g. 'merit-badge:first-aid'.

effective_from.description: When this revision took effect (transition/grandfathering rules go in 'notes').

effective_to.description: The date the next edition took effect; null = still in force. Windows are HALF-OPEN: an edition applied when effective_from <= D < effective_to, so this is the successor's effective_from and NOT the last day this edition applied. Consecutive editions of a subject abut exactly - no gap, no overlap.

supersedes.description: The immediately previous revision; null = earliest known (not necessarily first ever).

source_document.description: The publication this revision was transcribed from.

includes_official_text.description: True iff any requirement node carries verbatim 'text'. Lets a publish step strip or withhold official text wholesale. The flag <-> text-presence correspondence is a PIPELINE-ENFORCED invariant (see TODO.md 'Pipeline validator'); never trust the boolean alone.

text_rights.description: Rights statement for any verbatim requirement `text` in this set. REQUIRED when includes_official_text is true: requirement text is Scouting America's copyright, reproduced with attribution for non-commercial use and NOT covered by this dataset's CC BY-NC-SA license. See NOTICE.md.

completion_rule.description: The source's own statement of how many of `requirements` must be completed, verbatim, when it is not simply 'all of them' — e.g. 'Complete Requirements 1-4 plus at least one other'. null means every listed requirement is required. This is deliberately PROSE, not structure: the pre-2024 Cub adventures state the rule 44 different ways ('Complete Requirement 1 or 2 plus at least two others', 'Requirements 5-7 are optional'), and mechanically converting those into `choose` trees would risk publishing requirements the source never demanded. Publishing the list without the rule would be worse still — a consumer would read six requirements as six obligations. Any requirement number the rule mentions is pipeline-checked to exist.

Requirement.title: Requirement
Requirement.description: One node of the requirement tree. At least one of text/summary/children must be present. 'choose' = complete N of the children (null = all children required). Option groups (e.g. 'do 7a OR 7b') are a parent node with choose=1. A node that stands for another entity — a Cub rank's adventures, and in future a rank's named merit badges — carries `ref` so consumers resolve it instead of matching on name.

text.description: Verbatim official requirement text (© Scouting America). Presence requires includes_official_text=true + text_rights (see NOTICE.md).

summary.description: Optional original-prose paraphrase/gloss. Not a substitute for the official text; carries no third-party copyright.

choose.description: Complete this many of 'children'; null = all. Schema-enforced: a non-null choose requires a non-empty children.

ref.description: The entity this node stands for (e.g. 'adventure:paws-on-the-path'). Present when the requirement is 'complete that entity' and its own requirements live in the entity's requirement-set rather than inline here. `text` still carries the name as printed, so the document reads standalone. Referential integrity is a pipeline rule.

tenure_months.description: How many months of activity or service this requirement demands, as a MINIMUM. The source phrases it three ways ('for six months', 'for at least six months', 'for a period of at least six months'); serving longer never fails a requirement, so all three are recorded as the same minimum. Derived from this node's own text.

badge_count.description: How many merit badges this rank requires. Present only on the requirement that states them.

cumulative.description: Running total across all ranks once this one is complete.

from_eagle_required.description: How many of 'earn' must appear on the Eagle-required list. This is LIST MEMBERSHIP, not slots: every badge on the list is interchangeable here, so Swimming and Hiking count as two. Absent on Eagle itself, whose rule is the stricter 14-slot tree in 'children' - never a bare count.
